caption: The drawing depicts a wooden jointed doll with segmented limbs and a painted face. The doll's head is beige, with black hair, blue eyes, red lips, and cheeks blushed with pink. The body, upper arms, and thighs are rendered in a natural light brown wood color with visible grain patterns. The forearms and lower legs are painted a pale grayish-white. The doll’s feet are black, resembling shoes. The doll's joints at the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees are clearly shown with simple circular wooden pivots. The background is a plain off-white or light beige color, and there is a signature "Anne Coltman" written in the bottom right corner.
title: Doll - "Cynthia"
